name: Pearl Street central power station
summary: Edison's Pearl Street station in New York began in 1882 to generate electricity centrally and sell it through wires to nearby paying customers.
description: Edison Pearl Street central electricity station and local distribution to New York customers.

why: Edison's incandescent lamp needed a reliable supply of current delivered to many buildings, which a central station and wiring network could sell.
